en-US.description: hiro is a personal test build with customizable on-screen presentation, viewing protection and device connectivity.
en-US.whats_new: Improves recovery after interrupted requests and handling of recently updated device data. Adds recovery checks and diagnostics. Please check reconnection, progress and reminders.

zh-Hans.description: hiro 是用于个人测试的应用版本，提供可自定义的界面展示、查看保护和设备连接功能。
zh-Hans.whats_new: 改进请求中断后的状态恢复及近期设备数据的处理，增加恢复核验和诊断记录。请检查重新连接、运行进度和提醒表现。
